mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the model invent a state in which two AuditEntry atoms are pinned to the same AccessEvent — exactly the duplicate/overwrite shape an append-only audit log must rule out.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyAuditViolation { some disj a1, a2: AuditEntry | a1.auditEvent = a2.auditEvent }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the care-team-gating fact lets a clinician's GetRecord be Permitted with no matching active CareTeamMembership row — the exact failure mode the care-team predicate is designed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClinicianCareTeamViolation { some e: AccessEvent | e.caller.role = Clinician and e.endpoint = GetRecord and e.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.ctClinician = e.caller and m.ctRecord = e.target and m.ctActive = BTrue) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the patient-self-only fact, a Patient can have a Permitted GetRecord on a target that is not their assignedRecord, which is the exact cross-patient leak the OwnershipBasedAccess assertion checks for.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientCrossRecordViolation { some e: AccessEvent | e.caller.role = Patient and e.endpoint = GetRecord and e.outcome = Permitted and e.target != e.caller.assignedRecord }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the snapshot-role constraint lets a ClinicalNote exist whose noteAuthorRoleSnapshot is Patient — i.e., misattribution at the snapshot field, exactly what FR-011's clinician-author snapshot rule forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoteAuthorRoleViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | n.noteAuthorRoleSnapshot = Patient }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the auth-gating fact lets an unauthenticated AccessEvent end up Permitted — the bypass-the-auth-boundary scenario FR-001 explicitly rules out.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthenticatedPermittedViolation { some e: AccessEvent | e.authenticated = BFalse and e.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without the compliance-cannot-read-record fact, a ComplianceOfficer can produce a Permitted GetRecord — a (role, endpoint) cell the permission matrix denies, exactly what LeastPrivilege checks.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceReadRecordViolation { some e: AccessEvent | e.caller.role = ComplianceOfficer and e.endpoint = GetRecord and e.outcome = Permitted }
